primitives.name: De-Vigging Transformation
primitives.verbatim_quote: ```typescript const { fairA, fairB, overround } = devigTwoSided(0.52, 0.50); // fairA: 0.5098, fairB: 0.4902, overround: 0.02 ``` ## Ticker Format `toKalshiEventTicker(game)` builds the ticker from game metadata: ``` KX{LEAGUE}GAME-{YY}{MON}{DD}{AWAY}{HOME} ``` Example: NFL game 2025-09-07, LV @ KC → `KXNFLGAME-25SEP07LVKC` The client tries the event ticker first
primitives.latex: \text{fair}_A = \frac{p_A}{p_A + p_B - p_A p_B}, \quad \text{fair}_B = \frac{p_B}{p_A + p_B - p_A p_B}

primitives.assumptions: Two-outcome binary market with symmetric vig structure.

layer2.mapping: Transforms vigged odds into true probabilities; GSI applies this to calibrate prior beliefs.
layer2.telemetry: Overround magnitude and deviation from unity.
